title: RangeSlider configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.RangeSliderAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/ai-docs/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

InitialValueFrom.description: These variables hold the inital state of a RangeSlider

InitialValueTo.description: Value of the upper handle when the slider is built (interval mode).

IsInterval.description: Uses two handles (from/to) instead of a single one.

rangeSliderMode.description: Store rangeslider mode is in use

ShowFloatingLabel.description: Shows the current value in a floating label above the handle.

ShowTickMarks.description: Renders tick marks (pips) along the track.

Size.description: Track length (CSS length); 100% when horizontal, 100px when vertical.

StartingValueFrom.description: Current value of the (lower) handle, kept across provider redraws.

StartingValueTo.description: Current value of the upper handle, kept across provider redraws (interval mode).

TickMarksInterval.description: Distance between tick marks in slider units.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
